script.title: THE LATE RESCHEDULE
script.scene_zh: 牙醫前台 · 電話改約
script.story_hook: A 2 p.m. plan meets a 6 a.m. stomach bug.
script.intro_zh: 下午兩點的計畫，遇上清晨六點的腸胃病毒。
script.welcome_en: Hi, welcome to a last-minute change call. Listen for polite rescheduling phrases.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，歡迎來到這通臨時更改的電話。留意有禮貌的改約說法。
script.outro: And that's an appointment saved, fee dodged. Listen again and try it out loud.
script.outro_zh: 預約保住了，費用也躲過了。再聽一次，大聲跟著說說看。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each line together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起逐句跟讀。
script.char_a_description: a tired dad in his mid thirties with short brown hair and five o'clock stubble, a heather grey henley shirt, jeans, an apron tied on, and a broad build
script.char_b_description: a composed woman in her fifties with warm auburn hair in a low ponytail, cat-eye glasses, a navy clinic polo under a quilted grey vest, a gold name badge, and a tall straight build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I need to move today's two o'clock, um, appointment.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪ ˈnid tə muv təˈdeɪz tu əˈklɑk ʌm əˈpɔɪntmənt/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我需要改今天兩點鐘的預約，嗯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me see... the 2 p.m. cleaning for Owen Pike?
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi si ðə tu piˈɛm ˈklinɪŋ fɔɹ ˈoʊən paɪk/
dialogue.zh: 我看看……下午兩點的洗牙，Owen Pike 先生？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's me. I'm really sorry to call so late.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts mi aɪm ˈɹɪli ˈsɑɹi tə kɔl soʊ leɪt/
dialogue.zh: 是我。很抱歉這麼晚才打電話來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks for calling at all, a lot just don't.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks fɔɹ ˈkɔlɪŋ ɪt ɔl ə lɑt dʒʌst doʊnt/
dialogue.zh: 願意打來就很好了，很多人根本不打。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, here's the thing, my son was sick all night.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ hɪɹz ðə θɪŋ maɪ sɑn wəz sɪk ɔl naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 是這樣，我兒子整晚都不舒服。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh no, that changes everything, poor little guy.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ ðæt ˈtʃeɪndʒɪz ˈɛvɹiθɪŋ pʊɹ ˈlɪɾəl ɡaɪ/
dialogue.zh: 噢不，那一切都要變了，可憐的小傢伙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He threw up twice this morning, so we can't come.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi θɹu ʌp twaɪs ðɪs ˈmɔɹnɪŋ soʊ wi kænt kʌm/
dialogue.zh: 他今天早上吐了兩次，所以我們去不了了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Absolutely not, no one should bring a sick child.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈæbsəlut nɑt noʊ wʌn ʃʊd bɹɪŋ ə sɪk tʃaɪld/
dialogue.zh: 絕對不行，沒人該帶著生病的小孩前來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Exactly, um, so can we pick another day?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli ʌm soʊ kæn wi pɪk əˈnʌðɚ deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 就是這樣，嗯，所以我們可以換一天嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can, but I have to mention the fee rule.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kən bət aɪ hæv tə ˈmɛnʃən ðə fi ɹul/
dialogue.zh: 可以，但我得先說明收費規則。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fee? Okay, I'll listen, is it a lot?
dialogue.phonetic: /fi oʊkeɪ aɪl ˈlɪsən ɪz ɪt ə lɑt/
dialogue.zh: 收費？好，我聽著，金額大嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Changes inside twenty-four hours cost fifty dollars.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtʃeɪndʒɪz ɪnˈsaɪd ˈtwɛnti fɔɹ ˈaʊɚz kɑst ˈfɪfti ˈdɑləɚz/
dialogue.zh: 二十四小時以內的更改，要收五十元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fifty! Um, well, it is very last minute, yes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɪfti ʌm wɛl ɪt ɪz ˈvɛɹi læst ˈmɪnɪt jɛs/
dialogue.zh: 五十！嗯，好吧，確實很臨時，是的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is, though this is your first reschedule ever.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ðoʊ ðɪs ɪz jɔɹ fɝst ˌɹiˈskɛdʒuːl ˈɛvɚ/
dialogue.zh: 是呀，不過這是您第一次改約。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: True! Does that help at all, honestly?
dialogue.phonetic: /tɹu dʌz ðæt hɛlp ɪt ɔl ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 對！老實說，這有幫助嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sometimes... let me check my manager's note here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌmˌtaɪmz lɛt mi tʃɛk maɪ ˈmænɪdʒɚz noʊt hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 說不準……讓我查一下經理留的備註。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please, no rush, today nothing goes as planned.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz noʊ ɹʌʃ təˈdeɪ ˈnʌθɪŋ ɡoʊz æz plænd/
dialogue.zh: 拜託，不用急，今天什麼都不按計畫走。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, I raised three kids, I know that song.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ aɪ ɹeɪzd θɹi kɪdz aɪ noʊ ðæt sɔŋ/
dialogue.zh: 哈，我帶大三個孩子，我太知道那首歌了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He naps, I eat standing up, that's the day.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi næps aɪ it ˈstændɪŋ ʌp ðæts ðə deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 他在補睡，我站著吃早餐，一天就這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, good news, first reschedule gets one free pass.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊkeɪ ɡʊd njuːz fɝst ˌɹiˈskɛdʒuːl ɡɛts wʌn fɹi pæs/
dialogue.zh: 好，好消息：第一次改約可以免費一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Free pass? So the fifty is gone right now?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɹi pæs soʊ ðə ˈfɪfti ɪz ɡɑn ɹaɪt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 免費？所以那五十元現在就免了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Gone, waived, once, do not make it a habit.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑn weɪvd wʌns du nɑt meɪk ɪt ə ˈhæbɪt/
dialogue.zh: 免了，只免這一次，別養成習慣喔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Deal, no habits here, we're new to this city.
dialogue.phonetic: /dil noʊ ˈhæbɪts hɪɹ wɪɹ nju tə ðɪs ˈsɪti/
dialogue.zh: 成交，我們沒這習慣，剛來這座城市。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: New is fine, so when can you come instead?
dialogue.phonetic: /nju ɪz faɪn soʊ wɛn kæn ju kʌm ɪnˈstɛd/
dialogue.zh: 新來的沒關係。那您想改到哪天？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, later this week, after four is best.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm ˈleɪɾɚ ðɪs wik ˈæftɚ fɔɹ ɪz bɛst/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，本週晚一點，四點以後最好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: After four... Thursday has a four thirty opening.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈæftɚ fɔɹ ˈθɝzdeɪ hæz ə fɔɹ ˈθɝɾi ˈoʊpənɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 四點以後……週四有個四點半的空檔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thursday four thirty, yes, that's the one for us.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθɝzdeɪ fɔɹ ˈθɝɾi jɛs ðæts ðə wʌn fɔɹ ʌs/
dialogue.zh: 週四四點半，對，就是這個時段。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But it's the only late slot all week.
dialogue.phonetic: /bət ɪts ði ˈoʊnli leɪt slɑt ɔl wik/
dialogue.zh: 不過那是本週唯一的晚間時段。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, one trip is plenty for a week.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt wʌn trɪp ɪz ˈplɛnti fɔɹ ə wik/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，一週跑一趟就很夠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Will you drive here, or need a ride?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ju draɪ hɪɹ ɔɹ nid ə ɹaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 你會自己開車來，還是要搭車？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tricky part, my wife took our only car.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtrɪki pɑɹt maɪ waɪf tʊk aʊɚ ˈoʊnli kɑɹ/
dialogue.zh: 為難的就是，我太太開走了唯一的車。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So, you'd need the bus at that hour?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ju d nid ðə bʌs æt ðæt ˈaʊɚ/
dialogue.zh: 所以那個時段您得搭公車？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bus works, the stop is two blocks away.
dialogue.phonetic: /bʌs wɝks ðə stɑp ɪz tu blɑks əˈweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 公車沒問題，站牌離這裡兩個街口。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then give yourself thirty extra, buses run late.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ɡɪv jɔɹˈsɛlf ˈθɝɾi ˈɛksɾə ˈbʌsɪz ɹʌn leɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那就多抓三十分鐘，公車說不準就晚了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well noted, we'll leave by three fifteen then.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl ˈnoʊɾɪd wil liv baɪ θɹi ˌfɪfˈtin ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 記下了，我們三點十五就出發。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the kid, all better by Thursday, hopefully?
dialogue.phonetic: /æn ðə kɪd ɔl ˈbɛɾɚ baɪ ˈθɝzdeɪ ˈhoʊpfəli/
dialogue.zh: 那孩子呢，希望週四以前會好？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Doctor said two-day bug, so yes, probably.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdɑktɚ sɛd tu deɪ bʌɡ soʊ jɛs ˈpɹɑbəbli/
dialogue.zh: 醫生說是兩天的病毒，所以應該會好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two-day bugs are the fastest kind, lucky you.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu deɪ bʌɡz ɑɹ ðə ˈfæstɪst kaɪnd ˈlʌki ju/
dialogue.zh: 兩天的病毒好最快了，你們幸運。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lucky it's not the week we fly home.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlʌki ɪts nɑt ðə wik wi flai hoʊm/
dialogue.zh: 好險那不是我們要搭飛機回國的那一週。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh, travel too? Your family has a full plan.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ˈtɹævəl tu jʊɹ ˈfæməli hæz ə fʊl plæn/
dialogue.zh: 噢，還要旅行？你們家行程安排滿檔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, plan is a strong word for our life.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ plæn ɪz ə stɹɔŋ wɝd fɔɹ aʊɚ laɪf/
dialogue.zh: 哈，『計畫』兩字對我們的生活而言太誇張了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fair! Now, insurance on file, is it still good?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛɹ naʊ ɪnˈʃɚəns ɑn faɪl ɪz ɪt stɪl ɡʊd/
dialogue.zh: 合理。那檔案裡的保險，現在還有效嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, same card, um, do I have to redo it?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs seɪm kɑɹd ʌm du aɪ hæv tə ɹi du ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 是的，同一張卡，嗯，我要重新弄一遍嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No redo, the desk scans it when you arrive.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ɹi du ðə dɛsk skænz ɪt wɛn ju əˈɹaɪv/
dialogue.zh: 不用重弄，報到時櫃台會掃描它。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great. Can someone text me the new time?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt kæn ˈsʌmwʌn tɛkst mi ðə nju taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 好。可以傳簡訊告訴我新時間嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A text is standard, which number, the one here?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə tɛkst ɪz ˈstændəɹd wɪtʃ ˈnʌmbɚ ðə wʌn hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 傳簡訊是標準做法，哪個號碼，檔案裡這個嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, but label it 'clinic', my phone's very wild.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs bət ˈleɪbəl ɪt ˈklɪnɪk maɪ foʊnz ˈvɛɹi waɪld/
dialogue.zh: 對，但請標註『診所』，我的手機超級亂。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wild how? Unsaved numbers or many group chats?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪld haʊ ˌʌnˈseɪld ˈnʌmbɚz ɔɹ ˈmɛni ɡɹup tʃæts/
dialogue.zh: 有多亂？未存名的號碼，還是群組訊息太多？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Both, plus a cousin sending fifty memes daily.
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊθ plʌz ə ˈkʌzən ˈsɛndɪŋ ˈfɪfti mimz ˈdeɪli/
dialogue.zh: 兩樣都有，還加上一位親戚每天狂傳梗圖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, ours will be short: date, time, address.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ˈaʊɚz wɪl bi ʃɔɹt deɪt taɪm əˈdɹɛs/
dialogue.zh: 哈，我們那則會很短：日期、時間、地址。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's all I need, and thank you, the waiver.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ɔl aɪ nid ænd θæŋk ju ðə ˈweɪvɚ/
dialogue.zh: 我只要這些，還有，謝謝你免掉那筆費用。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My treat, your honest call made it easy.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ tɹit jɔɹ ˈɑnɪst kɔl meɪd ɪt ˈizi/
dialogue.zh: 我請客，你誠實的那通電話讓事情變簡單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I was ready to pay it, um, but thanks.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wəz ˈɹɛdi tə peɪ ɪt ʌm bət θæŋks/
dialogue.zh: 我本來已準備好付錢，嗯，但還是謝謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most people argue first, you asked nicely.
dialogue.phonetic: /moʊst ˈpipəl ˈɑɹɡju fɝst ju æskt ˈnaɪsli/
dialogue.zh: 多數人會先辯一場，你是很有禮貌地問。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My mother raised a politer man than me.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈmʌðɚ ɹeɪzd ə ˈpoʊlɪɾɚ mæn ðæn mi/
dialogue.zh: 我媽媽把我教得非常有禮貌。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She did good. Thursday, four thirty, be here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi dɪd ɡʊd ˈθɝzdeɪ fɔɹ ˈθɝɾi bi hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 她教得好。週四，四點半，記得來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What should I bring, just the card and me?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑt ʃʊd aɪ bɹɪŋ dʒʌst ðə kɑɹd ænd mi/
dialogue.zh: 我該帶什麼，只帶卡和我就好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Card, photo ID, and a list of any meds.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɑɹd ˈfoʊtoʊ ˌaɪˈdi ænd ə lɪst ʌv ˈɛni mɛdz/
dialogue.zh: 卡、附照片的身分證，還有在吃的藥單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Meds, right, I take one pill at bedtime.
dialogue.phonetic: /mɛdz ɹaɪt aɪ teɪk wʌn pɪl æt ˈbɛdˌtaɪm/
dialogue.zh: 藥單，對，我睡前會吃一顆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Write them on the check-in note. Bye, Owen!
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹaɪt ðɛm ɑn ðə ˈtʃɛkɪn noʊt baɪ ˈoʊən/
dialogue.zh: 寫在報到便條上就好。再見，Owen！

script.youtube_title: 【臨時改約牙醫📞】「計畫兩字太誇張」😂｜60句診所前台聽力🦷🎧｜免違約費改到週四｜Rescheduling a Dentist Visit
script.youtube_title_en: "Plan Is a Strong Word" — Rescheduling a Dentist Visit Last Minute
script.youtube_description:
「計畫兩字對我們的生活而言太誇張」——小孩半夜吐了兩次，下午兩點的牙醫預約非改不可，改約規則你聽得懂嗎？這一集是 60 句沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就在牙醫診所前台的電話兩端。

你會聽到：坦白說明臨時更改原因的開場句；二十四小時內改約收五十元的規則問答；第一次改約免付費怎麼講；換時段、改搭公車、保險資料留檔、請診所傳簡訊確認新時間的完整對話。

整段對話只用 A2 初級單字與短句，反覆出現美國人講電話的自然語感：um、well、so、ha、honestly。聽完你就會用：I need to move my appointment、can we pick another day、text me the new time。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓舌頭先學會，腦袋自然就記住。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請按訂閱與小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"Plan is a strong word for our life" — your son was up all night, and today's 2 p.m. dentist cleaning has to move. Can you handle the reschedule call? This is a 60-line immersive English listening practice set on the phone with a dental front desk.

You will hear: honestly explaining a last-minute change; the fifty-dollar rule for changes inside twenty-four hours; asking whether a first reschedule can be free; picking a new slot, planning the bus ride, keeping insurance on file, and requesting a text confirmation.

Everything stays in A2-level words, with the phone rhythm Americans use daily: um, well, so, ha, honestly. By the end you'll own phrases like I need to move my appointment and text me the new time.

The second half is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.
